answer_text: For IPsec sites with bandwidth of 100 Mbps or more, Cato recommends using AES 128 GCM-16 or AES 256 GCM-16. AES CBC should only be used for sites with bandwidth under 100 Mbps. GCM is more efficient and scalable than CBC, providing better performance and reliability for high-throughput encrypted traffic in the Cato Cloud. Also, ensure you use the same algorithm on both ends of the tunnel and avoid enabling multiple algorithms to minimize tunnel establishment time.
